text: ok hm its not snapping the same. so the test is lying or something. what u will have to do is get a log in place so i can properly show you. log when i place anything and its grid snapping, if u also identify what it is im placing u will see its not on the same grid
resolution: Placement lattice log landed (editors/build/placeLog.ts): every build commit path now console.warns one line per landed piece — id, kind, x/z/y, yaw, phase mod 3 — plus an ON/OFF-the-3m-module-lattice verdict with signed deltas. Wired into F2 (click place, prefab stamp) and the iso pane (click place, prefab stamp incl. which anchor was used, drag-paint, clone with its dx, move with its delta, rotate, tower shell), so the log identifies WHAT was placed, by WHICH tool, and exactly how far off-lattice it sits. Smoke-tested under v8cli: aligned stamps read ON, a 1m-offset stamp reads OFF(x+1.00) per piece. Hot reload picks it up; place things and the lines appear in the dev terminal (warn severity reaches stderr). Strong suspects already visible in the code: iso MOVE steps at 1m (not the 3m module), and CLONE shifts by selection-width+1m — either puts a whole room off-lattice, after which new on-lattice stamps can never line up with it.
